'''Lee Pullen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Melbourne tournament]] on 20 November 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base mains with docking bays and tech]], according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1490">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-24-melbourne-11-20-2000d1490/ melbourne-11-20-2000], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 24 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-24-melbourne-11-20-2000d1490/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
